list.name: booking
list.label: Booking (locator)
list.description: The booking's locator, as the CRS gave it. A regex: .* lists every booking traced in the range.

options.content:
A booking's trace starts where the CRS creates it (booking: the REST call, the screen or the MCP tool) and runs through its outbox to **crs-integration**, which starts the process in the **orchestrator** with the same trace; every task the engine dispatches — **mapping**, **crs-integration**, pms-integration — runs inside it.

The entry span carries `booking.id`, `booking.locator` and `hotel.code`; crs-integration's routing span carries `booking.locator`, `hotel.code` and `eventconductor.business-key` (the process key). Search below by locator, open the trace ID for the whole waterfall, or query Tempo in Explore: `{ span.booking.locator = "<locator>" }`.

panels.title: Bookings traced (one row per trace — open the trace ID for the whole waterfall)
What the booking's trace went through (its spans, by service)
panels.description: Every span of the traces whose entry matches the booking above: which services took part and how long each took.

targets.query: { span.booking.locator =~ "${booking}" || span.booking.id =~ "${booking}" } >> { } | select(resource.service.name, name, span.eventconductor.step.id, span.eventconductor.process.id)
